title: Rare/under-recognized: suspected vasospastic angina with non-obstructive arteries

symptoms: Brief episodes of chest tightness at rest, often overnight, resolving spontaneously.
Episodes are intermittent; exertional tolerance between episodes is relatively preserved. Symptoms alone are not diagnostic.
medications: Medication list to be reconciled; substances that may affect vasomotor tone should be documented by clinical reviewer
presentation.vitals: HR 72 bpm; BP 124/76 mmHg; RR 15/min; SpO2 99%; asymptomatic at the current snapshot.
presentation.initial_ecg_summary: Resting ECG normal between episodes; one fictional captured symptomatic ECG shows transient ischemic ST shift.
presentation.initial_troponin_summary: Serial hs-cTn remains below fictional threshold without rise/fall in this episode; electrolytes and renal function available.
